rubric.role_summary: Senior clinical database and CDI subject matter expert who translates clinical scenarios and customer practices into guidance for product and engineering, and designs digital experiments for healthcare revenue-cycle products.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior clinical database and CDI subject matter expert who translates clinical scenarios and customer practices into guidance for product and engineering, and designs digital experiments for healthcare revenue-cycle products.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bedside clinical background and clinical documentation integrity (CDI) experience.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in nursing.
- Either 5+ years leading Coding OR CDI departments within the revenue cycle, OR experience in a consulting or project-management capacity. The alternative has no separately stated minimum duration.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) process improvement cycles or nursing informatics research.
- Business, Management, or similar field and/or relevant experience.
- Bedside clinical background and end-to-end CDI knowledge, from frontline documentation to backoffice billing codes.
- Concurrent and retrospective CDI review experience in both inpatient and outpatient settings.
- QA, documentation, and training experience.
- Analytical, research/data science, and project management skills.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)
resolved_ambiguities: The phrase “Coding and/ CDI departments” does not clearly specify whether Coding, CDI, or both departments are intended.
The 5+ years requirement does not clearly state whether the duration also applies to the consulting or project management alternative.
interpretation.resolution: Coding OR CDI qualifies; the five-year minimum applies to the leadership route, not the less restrictive consulting/project-management alternative.
